message:
Evidence source SYN-0070 | Remote Desktop cannot connect to office PC
Problem: Remote Desktop cannot connect to office PC on Ubuntu. I already restarted the device once.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Enabled the approved RDP rule and verified the device was reachable.

Evidence source SYN-0044 | Remote access VPN drops after login
Problem: Remote access VPN drops after login on Ubuntu. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Updated the VPN client and re-created the connection profile.

Evidence source KB-008 | RDP Credential Repair - Guide 1
Remove saved Remote Desktop credentials and reconnect using the current organization account.
